title: 泰国榴莲与意大利白松露：开启一天的惊喜风味
intro: 以两种来自不同传统的香气开启新一天，别有一番滋味。一边是泰国榴莲，果肉柔软细腻；另一边是意大利白松露，以优雅而独特的香气备受珍视。
body:
TrufflElixir 泰国榴莲与意大利白松露风味糖浆由此诞生，为早餐、甜点和味觉享受增添一抹异国风情与精致气息。

灵感搭配：甜米饭、椰奶与榴莲

在泰国，榴莲常用于制作香甜浓郁的美食。想要体验一款充满泰式风情的早餐，可以将甜米饭与椰奶、榴莲果肉搭配，再淋上少许 TrufflElixir。榴莲的香甜与椰奶的柔滑相融合，最后带出意大利白松露的独特香气。

这款糖浆也适合搭配华夫饼、冰淇淋、酸奶、奶油及其他甜点。只需几滴，便能增添别具一格的芳香风味。

榴莲的营养特点

除了风味独特，榴莲也具有一定的营养价值。根据美国农业部（USDA）关于新鲜或冷冻榴莲果肉的数据，每 100 克榴莲约含 147 千卡能量、27.1 克碳水化合物、3.8 克膳食纤维和 1.47 克蛋白质。榴莲果肉还含有钾和维生素 C，以及包括硫胺素（维生素 B1）在内的 B 族维生素。具体数值会因品种和成熟度而有所不同。

这款产品将泰国榴莲的热带甜香与意大利白松露的馥郁香气融为一体，为喜爱探索新风味的人带来别致搭配，也让早餐成为一场充满风味的体验。

title: Thai Durian and Italian White Truffle: A Surprising Way to Start the Day
intro: There is a special way to start the day: with the aromas of two distant traditions. On one side, Thai durian, a tropical fruit with soft, creamy flesh; on the other, Italian White Truffle, prized for its elegant, unmistakable aroma.
body:
Their meeting gives us TrufflElixir with Thai Durian and Italian White Truffle: an original syrup created to add an exotic, refined touch to breakfast, desserts and moments of indulgence.

Inspired by sweet rice, coconut and durian

In Thailand, durian lends itself to sweet, comforting dishes. For a breakfast inspired by local traditions, serve it with sweet rice and coconut milk, add fresh durian flesh and finish with a drizzle of TrufflElixir. The fruit’s sweetness and the coconut’s creaminess meet the aromatic notes of Italian White Truffle.

The syrup can also be enjoyed with waffles, ice cream, yogurt, cream and other desserts. Just a few drops add a distinctive aromatic touch.

Durian’s nutritional profile

Beyond its distinctive taste, durian has an interesting nutritional profile. According to USDA data for fresh or frozen flesh, 100 grams of durian provide approximately 147 kcal, 27.1 g of carbohydrates, 3.8 g of fibre and 1.47 g of protein. The flesh also contains potassium and vitamin C, as well as B vitamins, including thiamine (vitamin B1). Values may vary depending on the cultivar and degree of ripeness.

The result is a product that brings together the tropical sweetness of Thai durian and the aromatic richness of Italian White Truffle: an unexpected combination for anyone who enjoys discovering new pairings and turning breakfast into a flavour experience.

title: TrufflElixir：当松露邂逅甜蜜世界
intro: 提到松露，人们往往会联想到咸味菜肴和成人餐桌上的精致料理。而通过 TrufflElixir，我们希望开辟一条全新的道路：推出一款以甜点搭配为主要用途的松露风味糖浆，让松露独特的香气融入日常生活中的每一个简单时刻。
body:
我们的创意从早餐开始。只需在华夫饼上淋上一些 TrufflElixir，代替传统的枫糖浆，就能以一种新奇而愉悦的方式，让年轻一代也有机会探索松露的独特风味。

TrufflElixir 拥有丰富的搭配可能：无论是冰淇淋、鲜奶油、提拉米苏，还是各种烘焙甜点，都能与之巧妙融合。对于热爱创意料理的人来说，适量添加几滴 TrufflElixir，甚至可以为意式烩饭增添一抹别具一格的风味。

TrufflElixir 系列包含六种口味：黑巧克力、草莓、香辣芒果、开心果、罗望子和马达加斯加香草。六种不同的风味演绎，共同呈现甜蜜滋味与松露香气的独特交融。

通过 TrufflElixir，我们希望让松露变得更加亲切、触手可及，邀请每一个人，包括年轻一代，在熟悉的日常时刻发现它的魅力：无论是早餐、下午茶，还是餐后甜点。

原来，松露也能在甜蜜世界中带来惊喜。

title: TrufflElixir: Where Truffle Meets the World of Sweets
intro: When we think of truffles, we often associate them with savory dishes and sophisticated adult cuisine. With TrufflElixir, we want to explore a new direction: a sweet truffle-infused syrup designed primarily for desserts, bringing the distinctive aroma of truffles into the simple moments of everyday life.
body:
Our idea begins with breakfast. A drizzle over waffles, replacing traditional maple syrup, can offer a fun and delightful way to introduce younger generations to the unique flavor of truffles.

TrufflElixir offers endless pairing possibilities: over ice cream, with whipped cream, in tiramisu, and across a wide variety of pastries and desserts. For those who love experimenting in the kitchen, a few carefully measured drops can even complement a risotto, adding an unexpected and original touch to the dish.

The collection features six flavors: dark chocolate, strawberry, spicy mango, pistachio, tamarind, and Madagascar vanilla. Six distinctive interpretations, all united by the harmonious combination of sweetness and the unmistakable aroma of truffles.

With TrufflElixir, we aim to make truffles more approachable and accessible, inviting everyone — including younger generations — to discover their appeal in familiar everyday moments: at breakfast, during an afternoon snack, or as a sweet ending to a meal.

Truffles can bring delightful surprises to the world of sweets, too.

title: 从拉齐奥到全球｜LuxurEat China 与 Ugolini Group 亮相 SIAL Paris 2026
intro: 2026 年巴黎国际食品展再次成为连接意大利优质食品与全球市场的重要舞台。
body:
2026 年巴黎国际食品展（SIAL Paris 2026）再次成为连接意大利优质食品与全球市场的重要舞台。作为意大利食品产业的重要产区之一，拉齐奥大区携 17 家生产主体——包括 16 家企业和 1 家合作社——亮相本届展会，向来自世界各地的专业观众展示当地食品产业的品质、传统与创新。

本届 SIAL Paris 汇聚约 8,000 家参展商，并预计吸引约 295,000 名专业人士，为食品企业与国际买家、经销商和行业合作伙伴建立联系提供了重要平台。

从意大利出发，连接中国市场

对于 Ugolini Group 与 LuxurEat China 而言，参加 SIAL Paris 不仅是一次品牌与产品展示，更是连接意大利生产端与国际市场的重要机会。

Ugolini Group 致力于将具有代表性的意大利食品与饮食文化带向更广阔的国际市场；而 LuxurEat China 则进一步面向中国市场，搭建意大利品牌、产品与中国消费者及商业合作伙伴之间的桥梁。

通过国际食品展会，我们能够与来自不同国家和地区的买家、经销商及行业伙伴直接交流，了解市场需求，并探索新的合作与渠道机会。

拉齐奥食品产业走向国际

2026 年，拉齐奥大区持续推动当地农业食品企业参与国内外重要行业展会，相关推广计划投入约 370 万欧元，覆盖超过 20 场专业展会。

SIAL Paris 正是这一国际化进程的重要组成部分。对于包括 Ugolini Group 在内的拉齐奥食品企业而言，国际展会不仅提供产品展示的窗口，也创造了与全球专业市场建立长期联系的机会。

今年，展会活动还通过与 AIC Lazio（意大利乳糜泻协会拉齐奥分会）的合作，将无麸质食品、合理膳食以及更加多元的消费需求带入现场烹饪展示与品鉴活动之中，进一步展现拉齐奥食品产业在传统之外对于品质、创新与包容性的关注。

将意大利味道带向更远的地方

从拉齐奥到巴黎，再到中国，国际化不仅意味着进入新的市场，也意味着建立新的连接。

通过 Ugolini Group 在意大利食品领域的产品与品牌基础，以及 LuxurEat China 对中国市场的持续拓展，我们希望让更多消费者、买家和合作伙伴认识来自意大利的优质食品，并为意大利品牌进入中国市场创造更多交流与合作机会。

SIAL Paris 2026 是这一过程中的重要一站，也是我们继续连接意大利与国际食品市场的新起点。

title: From Lazio to Global Markets | LuxurEat China and Ugolini Group at SIAL Paris 2026
intro: SIAL Paris 2026 provided an international stage connecting Italian food excellence with global markets.
body:
SIAL Paris 2026 once again provided an important international stage connecting Italian food excellence with global markets. Representing one of Italy’s distinctive agri-food regions, Lazio brought 17 producers — including 16 companies and one cooperative — to the exhibition, showcasing the quality, tradition and innovation of the region’s food industry to an international professional audience.

With around 8,000 exhibitors and approximately 295,000 industry professionals expected to attend, SIAL Paris offers a major platform for food companies to connect with international buyers, distributors and business partners.

From Italy to the Chinese Market

For Ugolini Group and LuxurEat China, SIAL Paris is more than an opportunity to showcase brands and products. It is an important meeting point between Italian producers and international markets.

Ugolini Group is committed to bringing distinctive Italian food products and culinary culture to a wider global audience, while LuxurEat China extends this vision towards the Chinese market, creating a bridge between Italian brands and Chinese consumers, buyers and business partners.

Through international trade fairs such as SIAL Paris, we can engage directly with buyers, distributors and professionals from different markets, better understand evolving consumer demand and explore new opportunities for commercial cooperation and distribution.

Bringing Lazio’s Food Industry to the World

Throughout 2026, the Lazio Region has continued to support the international development of its agri-food sector, with approximately €3.7 million invested in a promotional programme covering more than 20 national and international trade events.

SIAL Paris represents an important part of this internationalisation strategy. For Lazio-based food businesses, including Ugolini Group, these events are not only showcases for their products, but also opportunities to establish lasting relationships across the global food industry.

This year’s programme also highlighted gluten-free products and more inclusive food choices through a collaboration with AIC Lazio, the Italian Coeliac Association’s Lazio branch. Show cooking sessions and tastings brought together quality, flavour and attention to increasingly diverse dietary needs.

Bringing Italian Flavours Further

From Lazio to Paris, and from Italy to China, internationalisation is not simply about entering new markets — it is about creating new connections.

Building on Ugolini Group’s experience in Italian food and LuxurEat China’s growing presence in the Chinese market, our goal is to introduce more consumers, buyers and partners to quality Italian food while creating new opportunities for Italian brands to connect with China.

SIAL Paris 2026 represents another important step in this journey — and a new starting point for strengthening the connection between Italian food excellence and international markets.

title: LuxurEat亮相2026 FHC上海环球食品展：从早餐开始，探索意式风味
intro: 2026年11月10日至12日，上海新国际博览中心，N3馆 · N3A10展位，期待与您相见。
body:
一家人围坐餐桌，享用刚做好的松饼，为新的一天挑选喜欢的风味——这正是LuxurEat希望在2026 FHC上海环球食品展上分享的日常场景。

此次参展，我们将以早餐为切入点，介绍旗下特色产品的不同搭配方式。其中，TrufflElixir松露风味淋酱系列将成为重点展示的产品之一。

枫糖浆之外，早餐还可以有什么选择？

TrufflElixir将松露与不同的甜味及果味相结合，为松饼、华夫饼等早餐食品提供枫糖浆之外的新选择。

我们的想法很简单：让消费者通过熟悉的早餐搭配，认识不同的松露风味。轻轻淋在松饼上的一个动作，就可以开启一次新的味觉探索。

让松露走进家庭早餐

提到松露，人们常常想到餐厅和节日餐桌。通过TrufflElixir，我们希望探索更多日常食用场景，尤其是家庭早餐。

围绕有儿童和青少年的家庭早餐场景，我们希望以直观的搭配方式，让全家一起认识不同风味，发现各自喜欢的组合。

从认识产品，到尝试搭配，再到找到适合自家餐桌的吃法，是我们希望与中国市场共同探索的方向。

与中国食品行业伙伴面对面交流

在本届FHC展会上，LuxurEat将与Truffleat、CaviarEat及Ugolini Gourmet品牌共同亮相。

我们诚邀中国进口商、经销商、零售及电商采购商，以及酒店、咖啡馆、烘焙和餐饮行业的专业人士莅临展位，了解产品、交流应用场景，并探讨合作机会。

从家庭餐桌到酒店早餐，从咖啡馆到零售渠道，我们期待与合作伙伴一起，为消费者带来更多风味选择。

body:
A family gathers around the table for freshly made pancakes, each person choosing a flavour to start the day. This is the everyday moment LuxurEat hopes to share at FHC Shanghai 2026.

We will use breakfast to explore new ways to enjoy our specialty products. One of the highlights will be the TrufflElixir range of truffle-flavoured drizzles.

What else can go on breakfast besides maple syrup?

TrufflElixir combines truffle with sweet and fruity notes, offering an alternative topping for pancakes, waffles and other breakfast favourites.

The idea is simple: let people discover different truffle flavours through familiar breakfast pairings. A drizzle over a pancake can begin a new taste experience.

Bringing truffle to the family breakfast table

Truffle often brings restaurants and festive meals to mind. With TrufflElixir, we want to explore more everyday occasions, especially breakfast at home.

For families with children and teenagers, straightforward pairings can help everyone discover flavours and find their own favourite combination.

Learning about the product, trying different pairings and finding a place for it at the family table are ideas we look forward to exploring with the Chinese market.

Meeting China's food industry in person

LuxurEat will appear at FHC alongside Truffleat, CaviarEat and Ugolini Gourmet.

We invite importers, distributors, retail and ecommerce buyers, and professionals from hotels, cafés, bakeries and restaurants to visit our booth, explore product uses and discuss partnership opportunities.

From home and hotel breakfasts to cafés and retail shelves, we look forward to bringing more flavour choices to consumers with our partners.

title: LuxurEat、Truffleat、Caviareat 与 Ugolini Gourmet 携手亮相 SIAL Paris 2026
intro: 2026年10月17日至21日，四大品牌将齐聚巴黎，在这一全球食品行业的重要国际舞台上，呈现松露、鱼子酱及意大利特色美食。
body:
四大品牌，相聚巴黎

2026年10月17日至21日，LuxurEat、Truffleat、Caviareat 与 Ugolini Gourmet 将共同亮相 SIAL Paris 2026，在 Hall 1 – Regione Lazio（拉齐奥大区展区）展示以意大利卓越美食为核心的精选产品。

SIAL Paris 是全球食品行业重要的国际交流平台之一，汇聚来自世界各地的生产商、经销商、采购商、进口商、餐饮专业人士及行业决策者。2026年展会将在 Paris Nord Villepinte 举行，预计汇集约 8,000家参展商，继续发挥其在全球食品商业、创新及行业趋势交流中的重要作用。

松露、鱼子酱与意大利美食

四大品牌此次共同参展，希望通过精选食材、高端食品以及面向专业与国际市场的产品方案，从不同角度呈现意大利美食文化。

Truffleat 将带来以松露及松露制品为核心的产品，展现松露独特的香气与丰富的餐饮应用；Caviareat 聚焦鱼子酱与高端美食体验；LuxurEat 以精选高端食品为基础，呈现意大利美食文化与国际市场之间的连接；Ugolini Gourmet 则以对品质和意大利特色食品的持续探索，进一步丰富此次联合展示。

四个拥有不同品牌定位的名字，因为对产品品质和意大利美食文化的共同追求，在巴黎汇聚于同一舞台。

连接意大利品质与国际市场

参加 SIAL Paris 不仅是一次产品展示，更是与全球食品行业建立联系的重要机会。

在为期五天的展会期间，LuxurEat、Truffleat、Caviareat 与 Ugolini Gourmet 将与采购商、经销商、餐饮行业专业人士及潜在合作伙伴展开交流，了解不同市场的需求，并探索新的国际合作可能。

从产品本身出发，四大品牌希望进一步建立意大利美食传统、当代消费需求与国际商业机会之间的连接。

因此，SIAL Paris 不仅是一扇展示产品的窗口，更是让新想法、新合作关系与未来项目得以产生的平台。

当意大利卓越美食遇见食品行业的未来

SIAL Paris 2026 将继续关注创新以及正在改变全球食品行业的发展趋势，为成熟企业、新兴品牌和行业决策者提供交流空间，共同探索新的产品、技术和消费趋势。

在这一国际背景下，LuxurEat、Truffleat、Caviareat 与 Ugolini Gourmet 将以品质与意大利美食文化为共同基础，与来自不同国家和市场的专业人士展开交流。

从松露、鱼子酱到意大利特色美食，每一种产品不仅代表一种味道，也将成为探索新应用、新市场与新合作的起点。

巴黎见

title: LuxurEat, Truffleat, Caviareat and Ugolini Gourmet Together at SIAL Paris 2026
intro: From 17 to 21 October 2026, four brands will come together in Paris to present truffles, caviar and Italian gourmet specialties at one of the international food industry’s major global events.
body:
Four Brands Meet in Paris

From 17 to 21 October 2026, LuxurEat, Truffleat, Caviareat and Ugolini Gourmet will participate together in SIAL Paris 2026, presenting a selection dedicated to Italian gastronomic excellence at Hall 1 – Regione Lazio.

SIAL Paris is one of the international meeting points for the global food industry, bringing together producers, distributors, buyers, importers, foodservice professionals and decision-makers from around the world. The 2026 edition will take place at Paris Nord Villepinte, with around 8,000 exhibitors expected to participate, reinforcing the event’s role as a global platform for food business, innovation and emerging trends.

Truffles, Caviar and Italian Gastronomy

The joint participation of the four brands brings together different expressions of Italian gastronomy through a portfolio combining selected ingredients, gourmet products and solutions for professional and international markets.

Truffleat will place truffles and truffle products at the heart of the experience, highlighting their distinctive aromas and versatility. Caviareat will present its identity centered on caviar and fine gastronomy, while LuxurEat will showcase a premium selection connecting Italian food culture with international markets. Ugolini Gourmet will further enrich the presentation with its focus on quality and selected Italian specialties.

Four distinct brand identities come together in Paris, united by a shared commitment to product quality and Italian gastronomic culture.

Connecting Italian Quality with International Markets

Participating in SIAL Paris is not only an opportunity to showcase products. It is also a chance to create new connections across the international food industry.

Throughout the five-day event, LuxurEat, Truffleat, Caviareat and Ugolini Gourmet will meet buyers, distributors, foodservice professionals and potential partners, exchanging perspectives on different markets and exploring new opportunities for international collaboration.

Starting with the products themselves, the four brands aim to create stronger connections between Italian gastronomic tradition, contemporary consumer needs and international business opportunities.

In this sense, SIAL Paris becomes more than a showcase: it is a place where new ideas, partnerships and future projects can take shape.

Italian Excellence Meets the Future of Food

SIAL Paris 2026 will continue to place innovation and the transformation of the global food industry at the center of the event, bringing together established companies, emerging brands and industry decision-makers to explore new products, technologies and consumer trends.

Within this international environment, LuxurEat, Truffleat, Caviareat and Ugolini Gourmet will bring together quality and Italian gastronomic identity, opening a dialogue with professionals from different countries and markets.

From truffles and caviar to Italian gourmet specialties, each product becomes not only an expression of flavor, but also a starting point for exploring new applications, markets and partnerships.

See You in Paris

From 17 to 21 October 2026, LuxurEat, Truffleat, Caviareat and Ugolini Gourmet will meet food industry professionals from around the world at SIAL Paris 2026 – Hall 1 · Regione Lazio.

Five days where Italian flavors meet the international market, creating new possibilities for products, ideas and business relationships.

📅 17–21 October 2026

title: 展商推介｜TRUFFLE EAT S.R.L：携 LuxurEat 露意膳登陆长沙
intro: 第十一届中国国际食品餐饮博览会将于2026年9月18日至20日在长沙国际会展中心举行。TRUFFLE EAT S.R.L 将携 LuxurEat（露意膳）亮相 W2展馆 M10展位。
body:
中国国际食品餐饮博览会（简称“食餐会”）是内贸流通领域重点展会。首届食餐会于2016年举办，经过不断发展，专业化、市场化、国际化水平持续提升。

展会介绍

第十一届食餐会将于2026年9月18日至20日在长沙国际会展中心举办。本届展会专业展区提质升级，涵盖餐饮、食材、粮油、咖饮、预制食材、进口及休闲食品、复合调味品等，并设有智慧餐饮、酒店用品、生产包装设备、厨房设备、连锁加盟、生态农业及深加工产品等专业展区，打通食品餐饮上下游产业链。

展会规模约7万平方米，设置专家论坛、赛事评比、对接会等20余场专业活动，预计观众将超过15万人次。

企业介绍

企业名称：TRUFFLE EAT S.R.L

展位号：W2展馆 M10展位

LuxurEat（露意膳）在尊重传统饮食文化的同时，也始终秉持开放创新的理念。我们以产品的品质、特色与可追溯性作为甄选标准，并与资质合格且理念相投的合作伙伴携手，共同恪守负责任的采购原则与严谨可靠的生产标准。

产品介绍

LuxurEat（露意膳）的品牌根基深植于意大利美食文化、产品研发与匠心工艺。我们的特色产品多在意大利生产并包装；鱼子酱及其他高端食材原料，则精选自意大利及海外经过严格筛选的专业合作方。

凭借这一模式，我们既能呈现纯正的意大利风味精髓，又能充分适配国际市场对品质与灵活供应的双重需求。特色产品包括白松露油、番茄罗勒酱、黑松露酱、辣味番茄酱、蘑菇酱与意式青酱。

title: Exhibitor Spotlight | TRUFFLE EAT S.R.L. Brings LuxurEat to Changsha
intro: The 11th China International Food & Catering Expo will take place from September 18 to 20, 2026, at the Changsha International Convention and Exhibition Center. TRUFFLE EAT S.R.L. will present LuxurEat at Booth M10 in Hall W2.
body:
The China International Food & Catering Expo is a major exhibition in China’s domestic trade and distribution sector. Since its inaugural edition in 2016, CIFCE has continued to expand while strengthening its professional, market-oriented and international profile.

Exhibition Introduction

The 11th China International Food & Catering Expo will take place from September 18 to 20, 2026, at the Changsha International Convention and Exhibition Center. Upgraded professional zones will cover catering, food ingredients, grains and oils, coffee and beverages, prepared food ingredients, imported and snack foods, compound seasonings, smart catering, hotel supplies, production and packaging equipment, kitchen equipment, franchises, ecological agriculture and processed agricultural products.

The exhibition will cover approximately 70,000 square metres and host more than 20 professional activities, including expert forums, competitions, evaluations and business matchmaking sessions. More than 150,000 visits are expected.

Company Introduction

Company: TRUFFLE EAT S.R.L.

Booth: M10, Hall W2

LuxurEat embraces openness and innovation while maintaining a deep respect for traditional food culture. Quality, distinctiveness and traceability are at the heart of our product selection. We work closely with qualified partners who share our values, adhering together to responsible sourcing principles and rigorous, reliable production standards.

Product Introduction

The foundations of LuxurEat are deeply rooted in Italian gastronomic culture, product development and craftsmanship. Most of our signature products are produced and packaged in Italy. Caviar and other premium ingredients are carefully sourced from selected professional partners in Italy and abroad.

This approach enables us to preserve and express authentic Italian flavours while meeting international expectations for both quality and supply flexibility. Featured products include white truffle oil, tomato and basil sauce, black truffle sauce, spicy tomato sauce, mushroom sauce and Italian pesto.

title: LuxurEat携TRUFFLEAT与CAVIAREAT亮相Roma Bar Show
intro: LuxurEat集团携旗下品牌 TRUFFLEAT 与 CAVIAREAT 亮相 Roma Bar Show，与饮品、调酒及餐饮行业的专业人士共同探索高品质食材在现代 Mixology 与国际餐饮场景中的更多可能。
body:
Roma Bar Show

作为饮品与 Mixology 领域的重要国际活动，Roma Bar Show 汇聚了众多企业、行业专业人士与创新趋势。本届展会期间，在 ARSIAL 与 Regione Lazio（拉齐奥大区）的组织与支持下，包括 LuxurEat 在内的13家拉齐奥地区优秀企业组成联合展团参展，并围绕无麸质产品、食品安全以及更加包容的饮品消费体验展开交流。

TRUFFLEAT 与 CAVIAREAT

此次参展，LuxurEat 重点展示了旗下 TRUFFLEAT 与 CAVIAREAT 两大品牌。依托松露、鱼子酱及相关高端食材产品，集团希望进一步拓展优质意大利食材在餐饮、酒吧及 Mixology 场景中的应用，并与来自不同市场的行业伙伴建立更直接的联系。

无麸质与食品包容性

此次联合参展也特别关注无麸质（Gluten Free）与食品包容性。将安全、经过认证的无麸质产品与专业饮品及调酒场景相结合，不仅能够拓展产品的应用方式，也让更多消费者能够在兼顾食品安全的同时享受高品质的味觉体验。

对于 LuxurEat 而言，Roma Bar Show 不仅是一次品牌与产品展示，也是连接意大利优质食品产业与国际餐饮、饮品市场的重要交流机会。未来，LuxurEat 将继续携手 TRUFFLEAT 与 CAVIAREAT，让意大利美食价值被更多市场看见。

title: LuxurEat Showcases TRUFFLEAT and CAVIAREAT at Roma Bar Show
intro: LuxurEat Group participated in the Roma Bar Show, presenting TRUFFLEAT and CAVIAREAT and exploring new possibilities for premium Italian ingredients within contemporary mixology and international hospitality.
body:
Roma Bar Show

As a major international event for the beverage and mixology industry, Roma Bar Show brings together companies, professionals and emerging trends from across the sector. With the support of ARSIAL and Regione Lazio, LuxurEat joined a collective exhibition of 13 outstanding companies from the Lazio region, highlighting product quality, food safety and a more inclusive approach to beverage experiences.

TRUFFLEAT and CAVIAREAT

LuxurEat showcased TRUFFLEAT and CAVIAREAT, bringing premium truffle, caviar and related gourmet products into dialogue with the beverage and mixology world. The event offered an opportunity to explore new applications across restaurants, bars and hospitality while connecting with professionals and partners from different markets.

Gluten-free production and inclusivity

A particular focus of the collective exhibition was gluten-free production and inclusivity. Bringing safe and certified gluten-free products into an international beverage environment demonstrates how quality, taste and food safety can come together to create experiences accessible to a wider range of consumers.

For LuxurEat, the Roma Bar Show was both a showcase and a valuable platform connecting Italian food excellence with international beverage, hospitality and foodservice industries. LuxurEat will continue to develop the international presence of TRUFFLEAT and CAVIAREAT through quality, culture and professional collaboration.

title: 从广州出发，探索全球食品原料新体验——Truffleat、Luxureat 与 Ugolini 亮相 Marca China Private Label Fair 2026
intro: 9月8日至9日，Truffleat Thailand 团队前往广州参加 Marca China Private Label Fair 2026，并携四个品牌集中展示集团的产品实力。
body:
展会在广州保利世贸博览馆举行，现场汇聚食品、饮料、健康、美容、科技、工业产品以及面向未来的创新产品。此次参展，我们携 Truffleat、Caviareat、Luxureat 和 Ugolini 四个品牌共同亮相。

什么是 Marca China？为什么它如此重要？

Marca China Private Label Fair 与 Marca by BolognaFiere 一脉相承。后者是意大利及欧洲领先的自有品牌专业展会，而 Marca China 将这一展会网络拓展至广州，旨在搭建高品质生产商与亚洲乃至全球采购商之间的交流桥梁。

Marca China 至今已举办至第五届，汇聚超过500个食品及非食品类展位，吸引超市、现代零售企业、电商平台、MCN机构，以及酒店、餐厅等 HoReCa 行业客户。

小知识：HoReCa 与 MCN

HO = Hotel：酒店、度假村及其他住宿设施；RE = Restaurant：各种规模的餐厅；CA = Café / Catering：咖啡馆、咖啡店、酒吧及餐饮服务企业。

MCN（Multi-Channel Network）是负责管理、运营和支持大量内容创作者或网络影响者的网络或中介公司，主要活跃于各类社交媒体平台。

两天展会期间的交流

参加这样规模的国际展会，不仅意味着设置展位、销售产品，更重要的是获得与来自世界各地的采购商和经销商建立商业合作网络的机会。

在为期两天的展会中，我们的展位迎来了大量参观者。许多人对新鲜松露、鱼子酱、酱料、食用油以及各类意大利面产品表现出浓厚兴趣，并与团队交流了将 Truffleat 产品引入中国及周边市场的可能性。

四大品牌齐聚同一展位

将 Truffleat、Caviareat、Luxureat 和 Ugolini 集中在同一展位，是管理团队有意采取的品牌策略，旨在呈现一个专注于多品类、高品质、高端产品的集团形象，为寻找综合型合作伙伴的客户提供更完整的一站式选择。

我们从中国市场了解到什么？

此次亲身进入中国市场，让团队更加清晰地认识到，中国消费者和采购商越来越重视产品来源的透明度，以及品牌背后的故事。这与 Truffleat 长期以来重视产品品质并持续深耕松露专业能力的品牌定位高度一致。

Truffleat 的下一步

参加 Marca China Private Label Fair 2026 是我们发展道路上的又一个重要里程碑，也是未来更多新合作机会的起点。我们衷心感谢每一位来到展位参观产品、与我们交流并对我们的产品表现出兴趣的朋友。

如有兴趣购买 Truffleat 高品质松露产品，或希望成为我们的商业合作伙伴，可通过 Luxureat.cn、小红书（LuxurEat）或抖音（露意膳（上海）贸易有限公司）联系我们。

title: From Guangzhou to a New Experience of Global Food Ingredients — Truffleat, Luxureat and Ugolini at Marca China Private Label Fair 2026
intro: From September 8 to 9, the Truffleat Thailand team travelled to Guangzhou for Marca China Private Label Fair 2026, bringing four group brands together in one exhibition space.
body:
Held at the Guangzhou Poly World Trade Expo Centre, the exhibition brought together food, beverages, health, beauty, technology, industrial products and future-oriented innovations. Truffleat, Caviareat, Luxureat and Ugolini showcased the breadth of the group’s portfolio at one booth.

What Is Marca China and Why Is It Important?

Marca China Private Label Fair is connected to Marca by BolognaFiere, one of the leading professional exhibitions for the private-label industry in Italy and Europe. Marca China extends this network to Guangzhou, connecting high-quality manufacturers with buyers from Asia and around the world.

Now in its fifth edition, Marca China brings together more than 500 booths across food and non-food categories, attracting supermarkets, modern retailers, e-commerce platforms, MCNs and customers from hotel, restaurant and broader HoReCa sectors.

What Are HoReCa and MCN?

HO means hotel; RE means restaurant; CA means café or catering. An MCN is a network or intermediary company that manages, operates and supports groups of content creators and influencers, primarily across social media platforms.

Two Days of Connections

Participating in an international exhibition of this scale is about more than setting up a booth and selling products. It creates valuable opportunities to build business networks with buyers and distributors from around the world.

Our booth welcomed many visitors interested in fresh truffles, caviar, sauces, oils and pasta products. We also discussed the potential for bringing Truffleat products into China and neighbouring markets.

Four Brands, One Booth

Bringing Truffleat, Caviareat, Luxureat and Ugolini together was a deliberate strategy to present the group as a comprehensive partner focused on premium products across multiple categories, from rare ingredients to high-end lifestyle products.

What We Learned from the Chinese Market

First-hand experience of the market gave our team a clearer view of what Chinese consumers and buyers increasingly value: transparency about product origins and the story behind the brand. This aligns closely with Truffleat’s emphasis on quality and specialised truffle expertise.

The Next Step for Truffleat

Our participation in Marca China Private Label Fair 2026 represents another milestone and the beginning of new opportunities and collaborations. We sincerely thank everyone who visited our booth, explored our products and spoke with our team.

For product or partnership enquiries, contact us through Luxureat.cn, Xiaohongshu (LuxurEat) or Douyin (露意膳（上海）贸易有限公司).

title: 意大利国家展团首度亮相 Marca China 2026，携10家本土品牌集中呈现“意式制造”品质实力
intro: 意大利对外贸易委员会首次以国家展团形式参展，携10家意大利本土优质企业亮相 Marca China 2026。LuxurEat 展位号为 1D04。
body:
Marca China 2026（第五届广州国际自有品牌展）将于2026年9月8日至9日在广州保利世贸博览馆1号馆举办。展会预计面积达10,000平方米，汇聚逾300家优质制造企业，吸引全国10,000余名专业采购商。

意大利国家展团

本届展会的一大亮点，是意大利对外贸易委员会（ITA）首次以国家展团形式参展，携10家意大利本土优质企业联袂亮相。产品涵盖特级初榨橄榄油、精品咖啡、意式披萨、调味酱料、奶酪、松露、烘焙零食、蔬菜罐头、即食餐品及家居洗涤用品，集中呈现“意大利制造”的工艺传统与品质标准。

意大利企业希望通过展会与中国零售商及渠道商建立更紧密的合作关系，并探索与中国市场匹配的定制化、差异化产品路径。

意大利展团简介

展位号：1D04

公司：LUXUREAT

LuxurEat（露意膳）在尊重传统饮食文化的同时，也秉持开放创新的理念。我们以产品品质、特色与可追溯性作为甄选标准，并与资质合格且理念相投的合作伙伴携手，共同恪守负责任的采购原则与严谨可靠的生产标准。

主要产品

LuxurEat 的品牌根基深植于意大利美食文化、产品研发与匠心工艺。特色产品多在意大利生产并包装；鱼子酱及其他高端食材原料，则精选自意大利及海外经过严格筛选的专业合作方，以兼顾正宗意大利风味与国际市场对品质及灵活供应的需求。

title: Italian National Pavilion Makes Its Debut at Marca China 2026 with 10 Italian Companies
intro: The Italian Trade Agency will participate with an official Italian National Pavilion for the first time, bringing 10 Italian companies to Marca China 2026. LuxurEat will be at Booth 1D04.
body:
Marca China 2026 will be held on September 8–9 in Hall 1 of the Poly World Trade Center Expo in Guangzhou. The show is expected to cover 10,000 square metres, bring together more than 300 manufacturers and attract over 10,000 professional buyers.

Italian National Pavilion

A major highlight is the first participation of the Italian Trade Agency with an official Italian National Pavilion, bringing together 10 companies. Products will include extra virgin olive oil, premium coffee, Italian pizza, sauces, cheeses, truffle products, baked snacks, canned vegetables, ready-to-eat meals and household cleaning products.

Italian companies aim to build closer relationships with Chinese retailers and distributors while exploring customised and differentiated product solutions for the Chinese market.

Italian Pavilion Exhibitor Profile

Booth: 1D04

Company: LUXUREAT

LuxurEat combines respect for traditional food culture with an open and innovative approach. We select products based on quality, distinctiveness and traceability, working with qualified partners who share our values and adhere to responsible sourcing and rigorous production standards.

Main Products

The foundations of LuxurEat are rooted in Italian gastronomic culture, product development and craftsmanship. Most signature products are produced and packaged in Italy; caviar and other premium ingredients are sourced from selected partners in Italy and abroad, balancing authentic Italian flavour with quality and supply flexibility.

title: 意大利好味道来了！一站式探索自有品牌食品的意式创新
intro: 当意大利悠久的美食传统遇见不断升级的消费需求，一场关于风味、品质与创新的碰撞正在发生。
body:
从地中海橄榄油、传统意式酱料，到冷冻披萨、咖啡、乳制品及特色食品，本届 Marca China 意大利展团将汇聚一批来自意大利的优质食品企业，以地道风味、匠心工艺与现代生产实力呈现意大利食品产业的多元魅力。

从传统配方到现代工艺

从原产地甄选到自有品牌定制，意大利展团不仅带来经典美食，也将展示面向国际市场的产品开发与供应链能力，为零售商、品牌商及专业采购商带来更多高品质选品与合作可能。

LuxurEat

LuxurEat 将对传统美食文化的尊重与开放创新的理念相融合，致力于甄选兼具卓越品质、独特风味与可靠溯源的优质食品。

公司与专业、可靠的合作伙伴携手，坚持负责任的采购理念与严格可靠的生产标准，从源头把控产品品质，为消费者带来兼具传统风味、品质保障与创新体验的美食产品。

产品介绍

LuxurEat 酱料根植于意大利美食文化、产品研发与匠心工艺。众多特色产品在意大利完成生产与包装；精选鱼子酱及其他高端原材料，则由意大利及海外经过严格筛选的专业合作伙伴供应。

展会地点：广州保利世贸博览馆；展会时间：2026年9月8日至9日。

关于 Marca China

Marca China 2026 是中国聚焦自有品牌及 OEM/ODM 产业链合作的专业展会，预计展出面积10,000平方米，汇聚300余家优质制造企业，吸引10,000余名专业观众，覆盖食品饮料、家居日用、美妆个护、宠物用品、健康消费等品类。

title: A Taste of Italy Is Here! Discover Italian Innovation in Private Label Food
intro: When Italy’s centuries-old culinary traditions meet evolving global consumer demand, an encounter between flavour, quality and innovation begins.
body:
From Mediterranean olive oil and traditional Italian sauces to frozen pizza, coffee, dairy products and specialty foods, the Italian Pavilion will bring together outstanding Italian food companies, showcasing authentic flavours, craftsmanship and modern production capabilities.

From traditional recipes to modern production

From carefully selected ingredients at origin to customised private-label solutions, the Italian Pavilion will offer classic specialties while demonstrating product development and supply-chain capabilities for international markets, creating opportunities for retailers, brand owners and professional buyers.

LuxurEat

LuxurEat combines respect for traditional food culture with an open and innovative approach, focusing on products distinguished by quality, distinctive flavours and reliable traceability.

The company works closely with trusted partners who share its values, adhering to responsible sourcing and rigorous production standards to bring consumers traditional flavour, reliable quality and innovative experiences.

Product Introduction

LuxurEat sauces are rooted in Italian gastronomic culture, product development and craftsmanship. Many signature products are produced and packaged in Italy, while selected caviar and other premium ingredients come from carefully vetted partners in Italy and abroad.

Venue: Poly World Trade Center Expo, Guangzhou. Dates: September 8–9, 2026.

About Marca China

Marca China 2026 is a professional exhibition focused on private label and OEM/ODM supply-chain cooperation. It is expected to cover 10,000 square metres, bring together more than 300 manufacturers and attract over 10,000 professional visitors across food, household, beauty, pet and wellness categories.

title: CICC会员企业介绍：LuxurEat
intro: LuxurEat 由 Roberto Ugolini 创立，凝聚其超过25年的亚洲市场经验与深厚的意大利美食文化传统。
body:
Ugolini 来自意大利罗马，数十年来深耕亚洲市场，尤其是在泰国，致力于建立消费者和行业伙伴对正宗、高品质意大利精品食品的信任。

意大利传统与产品创新

LuxurEat 专注于采购、生产和经销高端意大利美食产品，包括优质松露、鱼子酱、精品酱料、食用油、调味品以及其他精选食品。所有产品均为意大利制造，在坚持传统与手工品质的同时，也注重产品创新。

在产品研发方面，Ugolini 与家人紧密合作，并持续探索新的产品形式，包括符合犹太洁食标准的产品以及适合纯素消费者的选择，以回应不断变化的高端消费需求与不同饮食偏好。

连接意大利与全球市场

凭借长期从事国际食品贸易与餐饮行业的经验，Roberto Ugolini 与亚洲及欧洲的厨师、经销商和进口商建立了广泛而深入的合作关系。他在市场开发、物流以及高端产品定位方面积累的专业经验，使 LuxurEat 能够将意大利优质食品与全球精品美食消费者的口味和需求连接起来。

LuxurEat 服务的不仅是专业厨师，还包括追求品质的消费者、进口商以及高端餐饮机构。产品目录涵盖新鲜及加工松露、松露风味食用油与酱料、手工调味品、纯素鱼子酱、Kosher 系列以及经典意大利腌制与保存食品，每一类产品都强调风味、可追溯性与真实性。

一座连接传统与市场的桥梁

LuxurEat 不仅仅是一个品牌，更是一座连接意大利美食传统与海外高端食品市场的桥梁。其在亚太地区、尤其是泰国市场积累的丰富经验，为有意开展精品食品进口、经销或商业合作的伙伴提供了宝贵的市场洞察。

如今，LuxurEat 正在积极筹备进入中国市场，计划将优质松露、鱼子酱及精品美食产品带给新的中国消费者，让更多追求品质的消费者发现和体验真正的意大利风味。

title: CICC Member Company Introduction: LuxurEat
intro: Established by Roberto Ugolini, LuxurEat expresses more than 25 years of Asian-market experience combined with a deep Italian gastronomic heritage.
body:
Originally from Rome, Ugolini spent decades in Asia, especially Thailand, building trust in the authenticity and quality of Italian gourmet food among consumers and industry partners.

Italian tradition and product innovation

LuxurEat is dedicated to sourcing, producing and distributing high-end Italian delicacies such as premium truffles, caviar, gourmet sauces, oils, condiments and other refined products. Everything is made in Italy, with a strong emphasis on tradition, artisanal care and innovation.

Ugolini works closely with his family on product development, exploring new formats including Kosher and vegan-friendly options to meet evolving luxury and dietary preferences.

Connecting Italy with global markets

Drawing on his career in international food trade and hospitality, Roberto Ugolini has developed deep relationships with chefs, distributors and importers across Asia and Europe. His expertise in market development, logistics and premium positioning enables LuxurEat to connect Italian excellence with global gourmet consumers.

LuxurEat serves chefs, discerning consumers, importers and fine-dining establishments. Its catalogue includes fresh and preserved truffles, truffle-infused oils and sauces, artisanal condiments, vegan caviar, Kosher lines and classic Italian preserves, each emphasising taste, traceability and authenticity.

A bridge between tradition and market

LuxurEat represents more than a brand: it is a bridge between Italian culinary tradition and luxury food markets abroad. Its Asia-Pacific experience, especially in Thailand, brings credibility and market insight to partners interested in gourmet import, distribution or collaboration.

Today, LuxurEat is also preparing its entry into China, bringing premium truffles, caviar and gourmet creations to Chinese consumers eager to discover authentic Italian flavours.
